title: CarrierAnswer
description: A Carrier's answer to a booking request, as the Carrier sends it to the Norvia Partner API (Carrier answer format, version 1). It differs from the Canonical Model on purpose: its own field names, its own decision and reason vocabulary, and a time with an offset. It never names the Carrier: API Management takes the Carrier from the token (ADR 0005).

carrierBookingNumber.description: The Carrier booking the Carrier answers, as the request named it.

confirmed.description: The Carrier takes the booking. By confirming, it accepts the Carrier cost in the request (ADR 0013).

bookingRef.description: The Carrier's own reference for the booking.

plannedCollection.description: When the Carrier plans to collect, with its UTC offset. Optional.

declined.description: The Carrier turns the booking down. The reason text is required for OTHER.

declineText.description: The reason in plain language. Required when declineReason is OTHER.
